name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in colleges and universities.
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with Aadhaar and mobile number.
Fill in academic details, institutional verification code (AISHE code).
Upload income certificate and marksheets.
Submit form and print confirmation copy for college nodal officer verification.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Aimed at empowering young women to pursue technical education. Maximum two girls per family admitted to 1st year of degree/diploma program.
documents_required: Admission letter issued by Centralized Admission Authority
Annual Family Income Certificate (issued by competent revenue authority)
Declaration by parents regarding girl child
application_steps: Apply through NSP under the AICTE scheme section.
Ensure institute is approved by AICTE.
Upload parent declaration affirming not more than two girls benefiting.
Institute verifies student records online.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
description: Supports undergraduate students across India pursuing full-time undergraduate degrees, prioritizing household income less than ₹2.5 Lakhs.
documents_required: Bonafide Student Certificate from College / University
Family Income Proof (ITR / Salary Slip / Income Certificate)
application_steps: Fill online eligibility questionnaire on Reliance Foundation portal.
Complete the application form with personal and academic details.
Take mandatory online aptitude test (60 minutes).
Shortlisted candidates undergo interview/verification.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
amount: Full Tuition Fee + Maintenance Allowance up to ₹13,500/yr
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to provide financial support to SC/ST students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
portal_name: National Scholarship Portal / State Scholarship Portal
documents_required: Caste Certificate (issued by authorized revenue officer)
Aadhaar Card seeded with bank account
application_steps: Select State Welfare Department or NSP post-matric portal.
Enter Caste Certificate verification number (digitally verified).
Submit bank account details linked to Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Physical verification by institute scholarship officer.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme
description: Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS) programme to assist students facing sudden personal or financial crises so they do not drop out.
documents_required: Identity proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License)
Current year admission proof (Fee receipt / ID Card / Bonafide)
Applicant bank passbook or cancelled cheque
Income proof (Ration card / BPL card / Salary slip / ITR)
application_steps: Visit official buddy4study HDFC Parivartan page.
Register with email/mobile and click 'Start Application'.
Fill in family background and academic details.
Upload all supporting documents in PDF or JPG format.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science and Technology (Govt. of India)
description: For students who rank in the top 1% in their 12th board examinations or crack top ranks in JEE/NEET and are pursuing B.Sc., B.S., and Int. M.Sc. in natural and basic sciences.
documents_required: Endorsement Certificate signed by College Principal / Director
Eligibility / Advisory Note issued by State or Central Board
application_steps: Register on INSPIRE web portal with personal credentials.
Upload board advisory note indicating top 1% cutoff.
Submit endorsement form signed by Dean/Principal of College.
Ensure SBI account is linked for Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Tata Trusts Medical and Healthcare Scholarship
description: Financial grants for students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate medical and healthcare streams across recognized government and private colleges.
documents_required: Current Year College Fee Structure & Receipt
Cancelled Cheque of Student Bank Account
application_steps: Visit Tata Trusts education grant portal.
Register and upload academic transcripts.
Provide detailed breakdown of tuition fees.
Submit application and track status online.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
description: Financial assistance to meritorious girl students belonging to economically weaker minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
documents_required: School Verification Form signed by Principal
application_steps: Log in to NSP and navigate to Ministry of Minority Affairs section.
Enter minority religion certificate and family income.
Get school verification form endorsed by school head.
Upload verified document and submit.

name: Adobe India Women-in-Technology Scholarship
amount: Full Tuition Waiver + ₹1,00,000 stipend + Adobe Internship
description: Recognizes outstanding female students in Computer Science, AI, and related engineering disciplines. Includes an opportunity for summer internship at Adobe India.
documents_required: Resume / CV detailing technical projects & GitHub links
Statement of Purpose (Essay: Why CS & Career Goals)
Two Letters of Recommendation from Professors
application_steps: Submit resume and project portfolio through Adobe's career portal.
Write three short technical essays on real-world impact.
Shortlisted candidates are invited for technical and leadership interview rounds.

name: State Pre-Matric & Post-Matric OBC Welfare Scholarship
description: State government financial aid for OBC students to cover tuition fees, examination fees, and maintenance costs in government and recognized private institutions.
application_steps: Register on state scholarship portal with Aadhaar OTP.
Enter OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate serial number.
Submit bank account details verified via PFMS.
Print acknowledgment and submit to institute scholarship desk.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled (PwD) Students
description: Dedicated financial assistance to encourage specially abled students (disability not less than 40%) to pursue technical education.
documents_required: Disability Certificate issued by Competent Medical Board (min 40%)
Admission letter issued by Directorate of Technical Education
application_steps: Apply through NSP under AICTE Schemes.
Upload certified disability certificate with UDID number.
Submit college admission fee receipt.
Institute verification online.

name: Vidyasaarathi ACC Vidyasaarathi Scholarship
description: Scholarship for underprivileged students pursuing B.E./B.Tech or Diploma courses, especially residing near operational plant communities.
application_steps: Register on Vidyasaarathi with Google or Email.
Search for ACC Scholarship Scheme and click apply.
Submit family profile and documents.
